main.description: An account's contact email for HappyProto, at rkey self in the account's at.happyproto.preferences/self space, written only as its owner. Kept in that space, never in a public repo: HappyProto drops any such record published to one. HappyProto mails only an address proven through a link it sent.

email.description: The contact email in use. Absent: the owner removed it.

pendingEmail.description: An address waiting for its link to be opened. Until then email stays in use.

source.description: pds: copied from the account's PDS when the space was created. owner: set or removed by the owner.
